entry.title: BILL048(25) (Honolulu): CR-261(26) Reported out for passage on third reading as amended in CD1 form.
entry.content:
RELATING TO PEDESTRIAN MALLS.

Expands Fort Street Mall to include segments of South Pauahi Street and Chaplain Lane and updates various provisions related to the exceptions to the vehicular restrictions on the mall. Allows the use of a bicycle at a speed no greater than 10 miles per hour and prohibits engaging in dangerous behavior while on a bike on Fort Street, College Walk, and Sun Yat Sen Malls. Takes effect on January 1, 2027.

Latest action: CR-261(26) Reported out for passage on third reading as amended in CD1 form.

entry.title: BILL016(26) (Honolulu): Returned approved.
entry.content:
RELATING TO THE REGULATION OF DOGS.

Provides that it is unlawful for an owner of a dog to allow the dog to become, or fail to reasonably prevent the dog from becoming, a stray. Requires the CSD Director or the head of the City agency designated by the Mayor to require the animal control contractor to enforce the provisions contained in ROH Chapter 12, Article 4. Increases existing criminal fines and establishes new civil fines. Requires the CSD Director to adopt certain rules.

Latest action: Returned approved.

entry.title: BILL033(26) (Honolulu): Returned approved.
entry.content:
RELATING TO FUNDS.

Establishes a special fund to be called the Parks Maintenance and Recreation Services Special Fund for the deposit of all revenues and proceeds generated by the DPR relating to the use of lands dedicated for park use or for park maintenance and recreation services, or otherwise earmarked for the restoration, operation, or maintenance of beaches and parks under the jurisdiction of the DPR, to be expended for DPR operations, parks maintenance and recreational facilities, and programs under the jurisdiction of the DPR. Establishes a special fund to be called the Botanical Gardens and Urban Forestry Special Fund for the deposit of all revenues and proceeds relating to the use of lands dedicated for botanical gardens, community gardens, and urban forestry programs and operations generated by the DPR, or otherwise earmarked for the restoration, operation, or maintenance of gardens and park and street trees under the jurisdiction of the DPR, to be expended for the operations of the DPR's Division of Urban Forestry a

entry.title: BILL032(26) (Honolulu): Returned approved.
entry.content:
RELATING TO PUBLIC PARKS, RECREATIONAL FACILITIES, AND BOTANICAL GARDENS.

Repeals certain specific fees and charges for the use of botanical gardens, public parks, and recreational facilities. Authorizes, by way of the delegation of such authority, the DPR Director to establish fees and charges by rule for the commercial and noncommercial use of parks; recreational facilities; and botanical gardens, excluding camping fees, under the jurisdiction of the DPR and requires that the fees and charges collected (except those derived from the use of the Hanauma Bay Nature Preserve and for any program, facility, or service under the jurisdiction of the Department of Enterprise Services) be deposited into a fund designated by the DPR Director. Provides the DPR Director with rulemaking authority. Establishes civil fines. Establishes reporting requirements. Requires the DPR Director to adopt rules within 450 days of the effective date of the ordinance. Takes effect upon approval; provided that the fees established by ROH articles and sections to be repealed will remain in effect until the DPR

Latest action: Returned approved.

entry.title: BILL031(26) (Honolulu): Returned approved.
entry.content:
RELATING TO CULTURAL SITES IN PUBLIC PARKS.

Establishes the process for including cultural sites in City parks in the program. Requires a stewardship plan. Provides the DPR Director with rulemaking authority. Imposes certain criminal penalties.
